extracted.name: Christmas spiced salt
extracted.description: Sprinkle this Christmas spiced salt over roast vegetables or pastries, or use it to brine your turkey. It features all the spices of the festive season
instruction_lines: Combine the cinnamon, coriander, grated nutmeg, ground ginger, ground cloves, orange and lemon zests and sea salt flakes in a small bowl.
Sprinkle the spiced salt over roasted or pan-fried veg or sweet or savoury pastries, or use it in a brine for a roast turkey.
